text:
Design work taught me more about mixing than any plugin.
All day I nudge spacing until nobody squints at the page, and no one can say what moved.
At night it is a kick and a bass, 3 ms at a time, until the low end stops fighting itself.
Same job. Different grid.
Ulek Mayang
